### KEY DATA CHARACTERISTICS

**Data Organization:**
- The codebooks define standardized failure codes and categories for each product
- The test_center_logs captures actual failures with bilingual descriptions (Chinese/English)
- Data spans approximately 4 months (August 5 - December 28, 2025)
- Contains information from 3 production sites (SZ, WH, CQ) and 4 production lines (L01-L04)
- Features 30 different test fixtures and up to 199 different operators

**Failure Categories Across Products:**
- ELECTRICAL (open/short circuits, leakage, resistance issues)
- SOLDER (cold solder, floating high connections)
- TEST_SYSTEM (fixture contact issues, probe wear)
- FW_SW (firmware/software issues: flash fails, verification failures, boot failures, version mismatches, calibration data failures)
- COMPONENT (missing, reversed, or wrong polarity)
- PROCESS (pressure marks, contamination)
- HANDLING (ESD damage, RF connector wear)

All files are complete and fully accessible at `/app/data/`.
